correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated every monotone Boolean truth table on n<=5 (counts including constants 3,6,20,168,7581), excluded trivial functions and improper games to obtain 1,3,11,80,2645 proper games. For each game independently evaluated exact Deegan–Packel coalition weights and Shapley–Shubik pivotal permutation counts, checked all player comparisons: zero differences through n=4, and at n=5 strict-reversal histogram {1:300,2:120,3:40}, hence 460 differences, no tie-only cases. Canonical relabeling gives exactly nine isomorphism classes and proper five-player dummy-free count 2330. The enumeration is exhaustive for n<=5, not a claim for larger games.

evidence: Prior result proves every proper <=4 game has same ranking, and all n=5 violations are weighted strict reversals.

value.rationale: FAIL as independent new mathematical contribution: the main natural five-player comparison and all nine types were already published. Further counts of how many reversed pairs and dummy-free incidence are easy finite tabulations from the already exhaustive older nine-class table; they do not independently establish a motivated previously unknown structural boundary. The original problem itself is valuable, but this record repeats its solved claim.

limitations: Finite only up to five players and ordinal comparison of DP/SS.
